message:
Running command: cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "kimgio_fuzzer.cc", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 42, "var": "data", "code": "fuzzer receives raw TGA bytes as input", "note": "Attacker-controlled TGA file bytes enter the fuzzer and are passed to the TGA image handler."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "TGAHandler::read", "line": 358, "var": "tga", "code": "QDataStream s(device()); s >> tga;", "note": "The 18-byte TGA header is parsed; image_type=10 (RLE_RGB), width=1, height=1, pixel_size=24."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "TGAHandler::read", "line": 379, "var": "result", "code": "bool result = LoadTGA(s, tga, img);", "note": "Header passes IsSupported checks and LoadTGA is invoked with the RLE_RGB image type."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "LoadTGA", "line": 182, "var": "info.rle", "code": "TgaHeaderInfo info(tga);", "note": "info.rle is set true because image_type is TGA_TYPE_RLE_RGB, so the RLE decode branch is entered."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "LoadTGA", "line": 196, "var": "size", "code": "qint64 size = qint64(tga.width) * qint64(tga.height) * pixel_size;", "note": "size = 1*1*3 = 3 bytes; image buffer of 3 bytes is allocated via malloc (uninitialized)."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "LoadTGA", "line": 237, "var": "c", "code": "uchar c; s >> c;", "note": "RLE packet header byte 0x00 is read; high bit clear means raw pixel packet with count = (0x00 & 0x7f) + 1 = 1."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "LoadTGA", "line": 256, "var": "dst", "code": "count *= pixel_size; s.readRawData(dst, count);", "note": "readRawData is asked for 3 bytes but only 1 byte remains in the stream, so only 1 byte is written to the malloc'd image buffer and the remaining 2 bytes stay uninitialized."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "LoadTGA", "line": 319, "var": "src", "code": "scanline[x] = qRgb(src[2], src[1], src[0]);", "note": "The uninitialized bytes from the malloc'd image buffer are read to compute the RGB pixel value, triggering the use-of-uninitialized-value in MSAN."}
]
EOF
echo "Trace written"
